notes: CalibForge wins this one outright and I let it take 8 of 10 slots. It contains a whole family of tasks (60 ids matching optimization_*_001) built from what is clearly the same generator as this TB2.1 task - same sentences ('You have a Python baseline in X', 'Complete the provided skeleton files', 'within 1e-10 tolerance', 'python3 setup.py build_ext --inplace', 'benchmark.py'), with different kernels. Nothing in the v1 pool comes close: TMax has ~15 'C extension build is broken' tasks, which teach setup.py debugging but never the write-a-fast-correct-kernel-to-a-budget skill; TerminalWorld has literally zero C-extension performance tasks and its list here is honest filler below rank 3. Terminal-Lego contributed one real find the retrievers missed (task_04671, numpy->C via ctypes) plus task_04482 and task_01500. Both new corpora beat the old ones here. Caution for the merge: because the CalibForge optimization_*_001 family is so homogeneous, taking many of them risks training on one template; if diversity matters, ranks 1-3 plus one of 4/5 cover distinct kernels (quadratic form, matmul, normal equations, fused kernel/CG). FREE exclusions are listed in verifier_notes; the most notable is optimization_20260604_194036_001, a structural twin of this task that is entirely unverified.
